title: Active and passive voice
examples: When should I use the passive voice in my essay?
What is the difference between active and passive voice?
Can I use the passive voice when I don't know who did it?

explain.say: First we look at who does the action in a sentence.
In the active voice the subject performs the action for us.
For example the dog chased the ball in the active voice.
Now we look at the passive voice where the action is acted upon.
The ball was chased by the dog in the passive voice structure.

draw.text: The ball was chased by the dog.

explain.say: We use passive voice when the action is more important than the doer.

faq.q: When should I use the passive voice?
faq.a: You use it when you want to focus on the action itself, or the receiver of the action. You might use it when the doer is unknown or unimportant.
asks: Is it always wrong to use the passive voice?
When is it okay to use passive voice?

faq.q: How do I change a sentence from active to passive?
faq.a: You change the subject to the object, use a form of 'to be' plus the past participle, and often add 'by' before the doer. Remember to change the tense correctly.
asks: What is the formula for passive voice?
Can you show me an example of changing it?

faq.q: What is the difference between active and passive voice?
faq.a: In active voice the subject performs the action. In passive voice the subject receives the action.
asks: Which voice is stronger for writing?
Does active voice always mean better writing?

faq.q: Can I leave out the doer in the passive voice?
faq.a: Yes, you can leave it out if you do not know who performed the action. For example, 'Mistakes were made' is common.
asks: What if I don't know the doer?
Is it okay to omit the 'by' phrase?

faq.q: Is the passive voice always grammatically correct?
faq.a: It is grammatically correct if you follow the structure: form of 'to be' plus the past participle. However, overuse can make writing weak.
asks: What is the grammar rule for passive voice?
Is it hard to make passive sentences?

facts: Active voice structure is: Subject + Verb + Object.
Passive voice structure is: Object + form of 'to be' + Past Participle (+ by Subject).
The passive voice emphasizes the action or the receiver of the action.
The active voice is generally more direct and engaging for readers.

quiz.say: The student wrote a long report.
quiz.show: The student wrote a long report.

options.show: The student wrote a long report.
options.say: The student wrote a long report.

options.show: A long report was written by the student.
options.say: A long report was written by the student.

options.show: Writing a long report was done by the student.
options.say: Writing a long report was done by the student.

quiz.why: This sentence keeps the student as the doer, making it direct and active.

wrong.0: This changes the word order completely and does not form a proper sentence.
wrong.2: This is grammatically correct but shifts focus away from the student.
wrong.3: This uses 'was done' which is awkward and not the correct past participle form.

quiz.say: The cake was eaten by the cat.
quiz.show: The cake was eaten by the cat.

options.show: Eaten the cake by the cat.
options.say: Eaten the cake by the cat.

options.show: The cat was eaten by the cake.
options.say: The cat was eaten by the cake.

options.show: The cake was eaten by the cat.
options.say: The cake was eaten by the cat.

quiz.why: The cake receives the action, so the passive voice is correctly used here.

wrong.0: This jumbles the word order and misses the necessary helping verb 'was'.
wrong.1: This changes the meaning entirely; the cat is not being eaten by the cake.
wrong.3: This is the active voice, which is also correct but changes the focus.

quiz.say: The famous book was published last year.
quiz.show: The famous book was published last year.

options.show: The famous book was published last year.
options.say: The famous book was published last year.

options.show: Last year published the famous book.
options.say: Last year published the famous book.

options.show: The famous book publish last year.
options.say: The famous book publish last year.

options.show: Publishing the famous book happened last year.
options.say: Publishing the famous book happened last year.

quiz.why: Since we do not know who published it, the passive voice is the best choice.

wrong.1: This word order is incorrect for English sentence structure.
wrong.2: This is missing the necessary form of 'to be' verb to show the past tense.
wrong.3: This is too wordy and changes the simple statement into a gerund phrase.
